componentDesc.enrich: Finds what the camera cannot show in the source text and suggests additions, without changing the plot.
componentDesc.extract: Pulls characters, locations, props and the timeline out of the text for the script and asset steps.
componentDesc.split: Cuts the novel into episodes in story order, each ending on a cliffhanger, with a hook at the start of episode 1.
componentDesc.script: Turns narration into scene headings, action, dialogue and delivery; every block cites its source paragraph.
componentDesc.img: Reference images for characters, scenes and props. Once locked, keyframes and videos use them.
componentDesc.text: Text that must be exact in the frame: notes, phone screens, signs. Every candidate is OCR-checked.
componentDesc.voice: One voice per speaking character; all dialogue audio and auditions use it.
